text:
Maya R.: starting shift handoff — ongoing incident summary below, please skim and ping if you pick up primary. I'm primary until 07:00 PT, Devin is secondary. Linh is out for the first hour (TZ overlap).

Maya R.: current pager state: embeddings-queue-length-high (P2), tokenstore-write-retries (P3). Root cause appears to be a steady surge in long-sequence embedding requests from a single customer tenant + prefetch storm.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER fired: embeddings-queue-length-high (alert id 98123) — threshold breach > 90% queue occupancy for 5m.

Devin K.: saw this earlier — we rolled a temporary ingress rate-limit to the tenant (ruleset r-emb-2026-03). Effect: queue length dropped by ~20% but still above 70%.

Maya R.: mitigation in progress: 1) temporary tenant rate-limit at edge (applied by Devin) 2) enabling fallback model variant (smaller quantized embedding model) for that tenant 3) adding KV-prefetch throttle.

Sam B.: I pushed the fallback route at 1799999005 — routed 30% of that tenant's requests to embed-v2-quant. Logs show increased CPU on the dedicated pool but latency per request improved.

Maya R.: visible customer impact: reports from support indicate degraded responsiveness in search for tenant "acme-intl" (approx 2% of platform traffic). No full outage. We'll keep metrics in grafana -> dash "emb-queue/tenant-acme" linked in runbook.

Linh T.: FYI I'll be back online at 03:30 PT and can take over primary if needed. Right now I'm on-call but on a different shift.

Devin K.: current ask for next hour: - keep the rate-limit, watch queue length - if queue > 85% again -> escalate to page SRE pager and consider burst-add of 1x gpu from dedicated pool (see play: scale-dedicated-burst).

Maya R.: runbook pointers: /runbooks/embeddings/queue-eviction (play 2: burst-capacity, play 3: tenant-rate-limit rollback). Also internal doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/embeddings-fallback-checklist (steps for routing and verification).

Sam B.: quick evidence dump (last 3 logs from embed router):
```
[1799998888] tenant=acme-intl req_id=abc123 seq_len=8192 route=embed-primary queue_len=128
[1799998899] tenant=acme-intl req_id=abc124 seq_len=8400 route=embed-primary queue_len=142 retry=0
[1799998910] tenant=acme-intl req_id=abc125 route=embed-quant queue_len=95 route_latency_ms=120
```

Maya R.: action items for whoever is primary next: 1) monitor grafana alert emb-queue:tenant-acme (p95, p99 and queue occupancy) 2) if fallback causes regressions (embedding similarity issues) -> toggle to 10% sample and open a ticket with Research to check degradation. 3) escalate to SEs handling acme-intl if customer-visible degradation rises above 5% error/latency threshold.

Devin K.: note on escalation: to add burst-capacity do `ops-burst --pool embeddings-dedicated --count 1` and then `curl -X POST https://infra-api.local/pools/embeddings-dedicated/scale?delta=1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"`. Watch for placement failures; if placement fails -> fallback to routing-only mitigation.

Maya R.: coverage gap: our eu-west secondary for embeddings is at 80% utilization — if we add burst there, we risk cross-tenant impact. Recommendation: prefer us-west capacity; I've placed a soft hold on eu-west scaling (ops-tag: no-eu-burst).

incident-bot: Note: pager suppression rule active for tenant rate-limit changes for next 30m to avoid alert flapping.

Sam B.: customer comms: support notified acme-intl CSM with high-level note. If we need to do a formal incident update, I'll draft a short status and share in #customer-impact for approvals.

Maya R.: handoff expectations: if you pick up primary, ack in thread and run the 10m check: queue trends, fallback error rates, embed-similarity regression sample. If everything stable for 45m, we can plan to remove tenant rate-limit and keep fallback routing at 10%.

Devin K.: I'm on standby for escalation. If P1 occurs (full request drop > 10% or multiple tenants impacted) -> escalate to eng-oncall pager rotation lead @pager-lead and notify infra-sre channel.

Linh T.: back online 03:33 PT — happy to take primary at 04:00 PT if Maya wants to rest.

Maya R.: thanks. Picking up anything urgent now? If not, I'll hand primary to Devin in 30m and move to secondary after that.

Devin K.: acked. I'll keep the bridge pinned and update with any changes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: scheduled check-in reminder set for 1799999300 (10m).

Maya R.: final note: I've attached the short checklist I ran for the last 15m in the runbook (verif: queue down -> sample checks passed). Leaving this thread open — please update with any changes or if you pick up the primary role.
